name: Sour buffalo skin
summary: Buffalo skin soured for a housewarming or a feast day. It is crunchy, with a light sourness.
taste: Báo Sơn La says crunchy, with a light sourness.
howToEat: At a housewarming or a feast, on that account. A salting time, an hour, and a price are Check on arrival.
where: The Thái feast table. A street was not named.
seoTitle: Da trau muoi chua in Son La — sour buffalo skin
seoDescription: Da trâu muối chua in Sơn La. Báo Sơn La calls it crunchy and lightly sour, for a housewarming or a feast.
